data.command: Tell me about your network configuration

data.text:
My network configuration. Well, we're running Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS here, with the Linux kernel 5.15.0-91. I've got my network interfaces configured in `/etc/network/interfaces`, and I'll give you a quick rundown.

We've got two Ethernet interfaces, `enp0s3` and `enp0s8`, connected to the internal and external networks, respectively. `enp0s3` is configured to use DHCP for IP address assignment, as we're on a managed network with a dynamic IP address. `enp0s8` is statically configured with an IP address of `192.168.1.100/24`, which is our public-facing interface.

Firewall-wise, we're using `ufw` to control incoming and outgoing traffic. UFW is configured to allow incoming traffic on port 80 (HTTP), port 443 (HTTPS), and port 22 (SSH) from the external network. Outbound traffic is allowed on all ports. Inbound traffic on all other ports is dropped. I've also configured UFW to log all traffic on `enp0s3` to `/var/log/ufw.log` for monitoring purposes.
